reasons.detail: R1 — `parseTestReviewJsonOutput` now normalizes parsed output with `normalizeReviewResponseArrays` for `blockingFindings` and `advisoryFindings` before schema validation, so omitted top-level fields are added as empty arrays.

R2 — The parser now normalizes only missing top-level fields (adding arrays) before schema validation, and unchanged schema validation still runs for parsed output. Tests in the diff explicitly assert rejection for non-array findings fields and malformed finding item objects, while still covering invalid input paths.

R3 — Top-level normalization is now applied before test-review schema validation, so accepted outputs still flow through existing parsing/artifact generation using blocking/advisory arrays, preserving existing PASS/ADVISORY/FAIL verdict behavior and count derivation from those arrays.
R4 — Diff adds shared helper normalizeReviewResponseArrays and uses it in test-review parsing and spec-review parsing via normalizeSpecReviewResponseShape, avoiding separate missing-array code paths.

R5 — The diff adds both a shared unit regression in tests/unit/flow/commands/review.test.js and a spec-local test file under specs/274-test-review-parser-repair/tests/ with a `// spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5` header, covering missing top-level test-review arrays and invalid item/shape rejection.
